implementation: Separate explicit editable transferable learning_skills from original concepts/project_task/practice_check; preserve all project constraints.
Search skill targets with existing fair request/detail budgets; do not require tutorial-specific project names or constants.
Bind every semantic teaching decision to real own video media proof, source fields, original quote, known IDs and fingerprint; title/topic and content evidence stay distinct.
At most two ten-pair model calls per job, no automatic retry, cached bound results and deterministic fallback; GET never calls a model.
Repair observed TWT own-code extraction and property-negation false veto with negative regressions.
Evaluate genuine useful skill support and student fit, not full project replication per video; unseen projects and rejected adjacent/superficial tutorials remain acceptance controls.
